## Description and Rationale

I'm registering for this challenge as a hands-on project alongside the Data Science Certificate I'm currently completing on top of my Executive PhD. Predicting taxi-out time sits outside my usual commercial/distribution lane (industry experience). This is a deliberate step into the operations side of the industry, applying what I'm learning in ML to a real, structured aviation problem rather than the commercial side I know best.
